name: Input

structurePatterns.layout: block-level vertical stack, label + field + error
structurePatterns.text: foreground text, meta-mono label, 11px mono error

colors.field: var(--background) background, var(--foreground) text, var(--input) border

pixelVariant.shadow: focus state uses var(--sh-px) 2px 2px 0 #000 instead of blur ring
pixelVariant.degrade: without --font-pixel, label falls back to var(--font-mono)

usageHints.whenToUse: Form fields, search inputs, text areas, dropdown selections
usageHints.accessibility: Associated label via meta-mono; error text below field
usageHints.doNot: Do not remove label for complex forms

doNotInvent: No helper text slot beyond error
No blur focus ring when pixelStyle=pixel

pixelLayer.note: Pixel fusion only touches the input's focus ring (hard offset shadow) and the meta-mono label (Fusion Pixel). Field body stays editorial. No separate .input-pixel class needed.

unknowns: Exact INPUT_CLASS padding values are encoded in the frontend utility file
